_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The 73.4% bottom analog and aligned fear_greed/momentum/gold factors point toward the Denial-to-Hope handoff, but the coil's 3% directional hit rate means this is a conditional claim on the named breaker firing, not a base-rate call.
next_move.brains_agree: Yes — both call UP into Hope; analyst is medium conviction with explicit confirmation gates, narrative is more structurally confident but does not name a different phase.
next_move.confirmed_if: fear_greed breaks 68 with btc_momentum_30d holding 60+ and retail_noise_velocity rising above 35
next_move.invalidated_if: fear_greed drops below 55 with funding turning negative and exchange_netflow spiking above 85
